summary: AIM ImmunoTech Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement of common stock, pre-funded warrants, and Class J warrants, raising ~$1.3M gross at $0.5189/share. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation like a going-private or tender offer. The board is not making a recommendation on a transformative event; the filing merely discloses terms of the securities purchase agreement. There is no premium, no target, no activist campaign, and no strategic review. The transaction closed June 10, 2026. No risk-arb angle; watch for stockholder approval of warrant share issuance.
